title: MCP Error Taxonomy
description: Standardized error classification for MCP actions.

type.description: High-level classification of the error category.

retryable.description: Indicates whether the client should attempt the same request again.

http_equivalent.description: Optional HTTP status code mapping for the error.

severity.description: Relative impact of the error on system operation.

details.description: Action-specific error context or debugging data.
